goals.name: Improve Sales Performance Engagement — Work with Jeff (Northwood)
goals.assessment: Green — real training output is now live, not just scoped. Trinity Session 1 (Jeff Johnson/Northwood, "Set the Agenda — Not Yours") was built and published org-wide 8/21, and its script directly seeded a new coaching check: a narrow, daily-cadence CET agenda-opener call-grading pass, with a measured day-1 baseline (15.9/100 avg, 39% of named concerns getting real follow-up). Session 2 (Sales Leadership Sales Training) ran 8/27 with Jeff, Cameron, Nhel and Therese Ablang — that leadership session is also what's driving the call-grading methodology pivot (Goal 1). Rep-level training paused around the leadership session and restarts Tue 9/8, split into two groups by day off so everyone can attend — one group Tuesdays, one Wednesdays, running four to five weeks. Amanda owns the $54,500 engagement spend; Cameron's card is support-only at $0 per his 7/30 ruling. 9/10 update: built and shipped a 100-pt CET call-grading rubric directly from Jeff's Call Map (quid pro quo, agenda question, differentiator takeaway, Save Your Ass, close), separate from the old 85-pt company-wide grader. First full run: 427 calls across 13 CET reps, 376 graded, company avg 53.6/100, 21 passing the 80-pt bar. This operationalizes Jeff's training into something measurable — real evidence the engagement is translating into a working coaching tool, not just training sessions. Run reliability is a growing problem though — last week's run got stuck entirely; this week's started at 7:30am and is still running, requiring the work to be split up and rerun in pieces. Next step: package the pipeline so Matisen can run it daily instead of this being a manual, unreliable process.
